items.question: What is this platform?
items.answer: It is a future unified AI platform for customer communication, approved business actions, and shared CRM context.

items.question: Which businesses is it for?
items.answer: It is designed for salons, clinics, stores, education, auto services, real estate, hospitality, and other service companies.

items.question: Which channels will it support?
items.answer: Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Gmail, SMS, web chat, and phone scenarios are planned. Connections will roll out in stages.

items.question: Can AI create leads and bookings?
items.answer: That is one of the planned capabilities. Each company will define what the AI is allowed to do.

items.question: Can an employee take over?
items.answer: Yes. Human handoff is part of the planned workflow for complex or sensitive situations.

items.question: How does AI learn about the company?
items.answer: The company will provide services, prices, hours, rules, documents, and other knowledge in its workspace.

items.question: Is every company’s data separated?
items.answer: The product is being designed as a multi-tenant platform with a separate workspace and context for each company.

items.question: Is the product available now?
items.answer: There is no public launch yet. We are collecting interest from companies for future early access.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This preliminary document explains data handling for the early-access form. It is not the final legal policy.
